business.title: Open a job position
business.goal: Publish a new job position with its title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager so candidates can apply to it.

steps.title: Open job position
steps.description: The recruiter enters the title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager, and the position opens.

steps.title: Review open position
steps.description: The recruiter checks the opened position and its remaining headcount.

outcome.statement: A new job position is open and ready to receive applications.
evidence: The position appears in the list of open positions
The position shows its hiring manager and headcount

business.title: Register a candidate and an application
business.goal: Register a candidate with name, email, resume link and source, and record the candidate's application to an open position.

steps.title: Register candidate
steps.description: The recruiter registers the candidate with name, email, resume link and source; an existing candidate is reused instead of duplicated.

steps.title: Find open position
steps.description: The recruiter searches for the open position the candidate is applying to.

steps.title: Record application
steps.description: The recruiter records the candidate's application to the position, which starts in the screening stage.

outcome.statement: The candidate is registered and has an application in screening for the chosen position.
evidence: The candidate appears in the candidate list
The application appears in the position's pipeline in the screening stage

business.title: Move an application to interview
business.goal: Advance a screened application to the interview stage and hand it to the hiring manager once the interview is done.

steps.title: Find application
steps.description: The recruiter finds the application in screening by candidate or position.

steps.title: Review screening
steps.description: The recruiter reviews the candidate's resume link, source and the position requirements.

steps.title: Move to interview
steps.description: The recruiter moves the application from screening to the interview stage.

steps.title: Send to hiring manager
steps.description: The interviewed application is handed to the position's hiring manager to decide on an offer.

outcome.statement: The application is in the interview stage and awaits the hiring manager's offer decision.
evidence: The application shows the interview stage
The application appears in the hiring manager's pending decisions

business.title: Reject an application
business.goal: Close an application that will not move forward, recording the reason for rejection.

steps.title: Find application
steps.description: The recruiter finds the active application to be rejected.

steps.title: Review application
steps.description: The recruiter reviews the application's current stage and history before rejecting it.

steps.title: Reject with reason
steps.description: The recruiter rejects the application and records the rejection reason.

outcome.statement: The application is rejected with a recorded reason and leaves the active pipeline.
evidence: The application shows the rejected stage
The rejection reason is visible on the application

business.title: Decide on an offer
business.goal: Decide whether an interviewed candidate for one of my positions receives an offer.

steps.title: Find interviewed application
steps.description: The hiring manager finds an application in the interview stage among the positions she manages.

steps.title: Review candidate
steps.description: The hiring manager reviews the candidate's resume link, source and application history.

steps.title: Offer or decline
steps.description: The hiring manager chooses between extending an offer or declining the candidate.

steps.title: Move to offer
steps.description: When she chooses to offer, the hiring manager moves the application to the offer stage.

steps.title: Return to recruiter
steps.description: When she declines, the application goes back to the recruiter to be rejected with a reason.

outcome.statement: The application is either in the offer stage or returned to the recruiter for rejection.
evidence: The application shows the offer stage, or
The recruiter sees the application flagged for rejection

business.title: Decide on hiring
business.goal: Decide whether a candidate in the offer stage is hired for one of my positions, taking the position's remaining headcount into account.

steps.title: Find application in offer
steps.description: The hiring manager finds an application in the offer stage among her positions.

steps.title: Review offer
steps.description: The hiring manager reviews the application and the offer extended to the candidate.

steps.title: Check remaining headcount
steps.description: The hiring manager checks the position's headcount, hires so far and remaining openings.

steps.title: Hire or decline
steps.description: The hiring manager chooses between hiring the candidate or declining.

steps.title: Mark as hired
steps.description: When she chooses to hire, the application moves to hired; if the position's headcount is now filled, the position closes automatically.

steps.title: Return to recruiter
steps.description: When she declines, the application goes back to the recruiter to be rejected with a reason.

outcome.statement: The candidate is hired, or the application is returned to the recruiter for rejection; a position with filled headcount is closed.
evidence: The application shows the hired stage
The position shows as closed when its headcount is filled
The recruiter sees declined applications to reject

business.title: Review my positions' pipeline
business.goal: Follow the progress of applications across the job positions I manage.

steps.title: Find my positions
steps.description: The hiring manager lists the job positions she manages.

steps.title: View position status
steps.description: The hiring manager sees headcount, hires so far and whether the position is open or closed.

steps.title: View applications by stage
steps.description: The hiring manager views the position's applications grouped by stage.

outcome.statement: The hiring manager knows where each application of her positions stands.
evidence: Applications are shown by stage for each managed position
Each position shows its filled and remaining headcount
